name: Polymarket International
rootCause: Polymarket suffered a third-party supply chain attack where hackers injected a malicious script into the platform's frontend, draining approximately $3.1 million in PUSD from 11 user wallets. Funds were moved from Polygon to Ethereum. Polymarket contained the incident, removed the affected dependency, and promised full refunds to impacted users.

descriptions.text: Polymarket suffered a third-party supply chain attack where hackers injected a malicious script into the platform's frontend, draining approximately $3.1 million in PUSD from 11 user wallets. Funds were moved from Polygon to Ethereum. Polymarket contained the incident, removed the affected dependency, and promised full refunds to impacted users.

Polymarket International's frontend was compromised by a supply-chain attack on 25 June 2026, resulting in the theft of approximately $2.94,$3.1 million in PUSD from user wallets on Polygon. Malicious JavaScript injected through a third-party vendor dependency redirected user approvals, draining funds. Smart contracts and backend infrastructure were not affected. Polymarket removed the vendor dependency and pledged full reimbursement, but the compromised dependency and primary chain transaction evidence remain undisclosed. A third-party vendor dependency loaded by Polymarket's frontend was compromised, allowing an attacker to inject malicious JavaScript.…
